notablePrerequisites:
Wirewood Channeler does not have summoning sickness.
There are at least four Elves on the battlefield.
description:
Activate Wirewood Channeler by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G} or {W}{W}{W}{W}.
Activate Seedcradle Witch by paying {2}{G}{W}, untapping Wirewood Channeler and giving it +3/+3 until end of turn.
Repeat.
If there are at least five Elves on the battlefield, this combo nets infinite colored mana.
